title: Registrations are open for the 6th National Pharmacovigilance Week Campaign on 21st September, 2026 at BHIM Hall, Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi
bodyHtml:
Registrations are open for the 6th National Pharmacovigilance Week Campaign on 21st September 2026 at BHIM Hall, Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi, organized by National Coordination Centre - Pharmacovigilance Programme of India, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission

Mode: Physical

Registration Fees:

  • For Industry Professionals/ Healthcare Professionals/Others: ₹1180/- (including 18% GST)
  • For Students/Research Scholars/Faculty Members: ₹590/- (including 18% GST)

Registration Link:

  • Online Registration Link for Industry Professionals/ Healthcare Professionals/ Others: National Pharmacovigilance Week 2026 Registration Form for Industry Professionals/ Healthcare Professionals/Others (opens in a new tab)
  • Online Registration Link for Students/Research Scholars/Faculty Members: National Pharmacovigilance Week 2026 Registration Form for Students/Research Scholars/Faculty Members

    (opens in a new tab)
